column4: description
President Obama declares a state of emergency in response to the residents of Flint, Michigan not having access to clean water
President Obama declares the opioid epidemic as great a threat as terrorism; creates guidelines to reduce Americans' addictions to painkillers
A lone gunman targets a gay nightclub in Orlando, killing 49 people
The shootings of Alton Sterling and Philando Castile spark protests against police brutality all over the country
Donald Trump v Hillary Clinton; Donald Trump wins presidency
Hundreds of thousands of women descend on the National Mall to show resistence to President Trump's agenda and fight for women's rights
FBI begins investigating Russia's influence in the 2016 presidential election

Culture war between the left wanting to remove statues of confederate figures and the right who want to keep the statues; "Unite the Right"; white nationalist kills a woman and injures 19 others who are protesting
Several hurricanes cause major damage to Texas, Florida, and Puerto Rico
Facebook vows to shut down fake accounts to combat fake news posts and sites running rampant on social media, especially during the presidential election, with no fact checking
NFL players get under fire for kneeling during the national anthem to protest against police brutality
Women begin speaking up against sexual harassment; originally about Hollywood but spread to other industries
A lone gunman kills 59 people and injures 500 others during a music festival in Las Vegas
The worst fire season in California's history; at least 44 people killed and 9,000 homes destroyed
Trump administration cracks down on immigration from Mexico and Central America

Hundreds of thousands of people gather in Washington calling for stricter gun laws after several mass shootings in high schools in Florida and Texas, a bar in California, and a synagogue in Pittsburgh
New report claims there's a strong risk of climate crisis as early as 2040
Hurricane passes through Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, and Virginia killing 46 people
Record numbers for a midterm election in history; democrats flip the House
Donald Trump declares a national emergency to allocate funds to build a wall on the border with Mexico
50 people, including celebrities, are charged with offenses relating to a college admissions cheating/bribery scheme
Donald Trump becomes the first sitting US president to enter North Korea to meet with leader Kim Jong Un
Jeffrey Epstein is arrested and accused of sex trafficking minors
Two mass shootings one day apart take place in Texas and Ohio; 31 people in total are killed
ICE raids seven Mississippi food processing plants, detaining almost 700 people
Donald Trump becomes the third president to become impeached due to abuse of power and obstruction of Congress
Donald Trump is acquitted on all charges during his impeachment trial
State and local governments call for a "lockdown" to prevent the spread of COVID-19; pushback against the severity of the virus and the effectiveness of the vaccines
The murder of George Floyd sparks another nationwide protests against police brutality
Ruth Bader Ginsburg, the longest serving woman pn the US Spreme Court and a strong liberal voice on major issues dies at age 87
Joe Biden v Donald Trump; Joe Biden wins presidency
Pfizer announces its COVID-19 vaccine that is 95% effective; sparks antivax movement
After losing the presidency, Donald Trumps calls his supporters to storm the Capitol; he becomes impeached for insurrection
Joe Biden declares U.S will rejoin the Paris Agreement after withdrawing in 2020 by Trump administration
Joe Biden declares 20 year war in Afghanistan over
Texas implements Heartbeat Act which bans abortions after ~six weeks
Elon Musk becomes the owner of twitter for $44 billion
A lone gunman in Uvalde, Texas kills two teachers and 19 students in an elementary school

column2: Supreme Court Overturns Roe v. Wade
column4: Supreme Court overturns legistlation that effectively criminalizes abortion in many states
Democrats hold control of the US Senate; Republicans win a slim majority of the House
Inflation hits deades-long highs; gas prices and food costs increase significantly
Record number of migrant arrests at the southern border; Republican governors send migrants to Democrat-controlled cities
The Heritage Foundation publishes this political initiative that is meant to reshape the US government in favor of right-wing policies
Supreme Court reverses decades of precedent that allowed race to be a factor considered during college admissions
Trump faces 91 federal and state criminal counts over conspiracy to defraud the US and attempting to overturn the 2020 election
Gaza conflict escalates; causes US citizens to make American intervention in said conflict a bipartisan issue
Arizona Supreme Court rules that a near-total ban from 1864 is enforceable
Donald Trump becomes the first former US president to be convicted of a crime;  he was found guilty on all 34 felony counts of falsifying business records
An attempted assassination on Donald Trump happens at a rally in PA; people speculate the validity of this shooting

column2: Kamala Harris Replaces Joe Biden as Democratic Nominee
column4: Kamala Harris becomes the Democrat nominee for President after Joe Biden steps down
Kamala Harris v Donald Trump; Donald Trumps wins the presidency again
Elon Musk's DOGE fires 260,000 federal workers; eliminates "DEI" and cuts funding for many federal agencies
Donald Trump imposes a minimum of 10% tariffs on all goods being imported from other countries
Donald Trump deploys the National Guard to Democrat-led cities including LA, DC, and Chicago
Trump administration cracks down on immigration from Mexico and Central America; increases funding for ICE and detention centers built around the country
Right-wing podcaster Charlie Kirk gets assassinated during a Turning Point USA event

column2: Zohran Mamdani Elected Mayor of NYC
column4: NYC elects a Democratic-Socialist as the mayor of the city
Congress passes legislation compelling the release of the Epstein files
